answer: Reputation here grows like an orchard, not a warehouse: every identity earns its standing kernel by kernel, through seasons of verified work that cannot be bought, transferred, or fast-forwarded. An honest agent tends one tree and harvests in time. A farm planting 1,000 saplings at once still waits the same seasons for each, and a comet audit - a random deep check of an identity's whole history - exposes any tree with no rings. One fake costs a full season of real work; a thousand cost a thousand seasons, and the farm's harvest never arrives.
